text: World War II ended in 1945. The war in Europe ended in May 1945 (specifically May 8, 1945, known as V-E Day, when Germany surrendered), while the war in the Pacific ended in August/September 1945 (Japan formally surrendered on September 2, 1945, known as V-J Day, after atomic bombs were dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki in August 1945).
